details:
1. Open the VRChat app on iPhone and sign into my VRChat account.

2. Tap the Friends/Social tab.

3. Select “Online Friends.”

4. The app displays “No Results,” even though multiple friends are currently online.

5. Open vrchat.com in Safari on the same iPhone and sign into the same VRChat account.

6. The website correctly displays my online friends and their current locations/instances.

7. I have logged out and back into the iOS app, deleted and reinstalled VRChat, and rebooted the iPhone. The issue persists.

8. Other account data loads correctly in the app, including my profile, worlds, live events, groups, and VRC credits.

9. My active VRC+ subscription also does not appear to be indicated on my profile in the iOS app, which may be related to the account-data synchronization issue.

Expected: Online friends shown in the iOS app should match the friends shown as online on vrchat.com.

Actual: The iOS app shows “No Results,” while vrchat.com correctly shows multiple online friends.
title: iOS app shows no online friends while vrchat.com shows friends online
